attributes.context: The Adjutant General of Michigan and the Laborers International Union of North America (LIUNA) agree that the collective bargaining agreement serves several purposes, including promoting harmonious relations and good faith negotiations.

extraction_text: Supports the development and implementation of modern and progressive work practices to facilitate and improve organizational performance and the efficient accomplishment of Agency operations.

attributes.context: Section 18.1 - Job Related Training and Qualifications

extraction_text: The Parties recognize that changes in the work place will continue as technology, new techniques, material, and equipment are developed and employed. Each Employee is responsible for taking the initiative necessary to keep abreast of these changes.

attributes.context: This provision is located in Article 4 (Management Rights), Section 4.2, regarding Retained Rights and Impact and Implementation (I&I).
